contents.text:
This trim requires Minecraft Level VI, Tank Level IV, and Vital completion

It provides +8 Health Points and Resistance II but Slowness I

With a full set you also get the Last Stand ability. This ability allows you to cheat death similarly to a totem. If you are ever at two hearts, 4 health points, or less the ability will trigger and give you regeneration, absorption, speed, strength, and increased resistance. This ability has a 10 minute cooldown. It will not trigger if you lose too much health too quickly.

It can be found in Ancient Cities

Each Ward piece provides +3 Health Points.
